positions.title: Web Applications Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed web applications for music marketing using HTML, CSS, Javascript/AJAX/DOM, Prototype, YUI, Flash, and Ruby on Rails.
* Developed new features for geo targeting and data visualization with integration of 3rd party APIs such as google maps.
* Developed prototypes and functional mockups of new UI concepts for user experience testing.
* Implemented front end performance optimizations to existing code to enhance user experience.
* Worked with product managers, interaction designers, and visual designers to enhance experience for Topspin users. 
* Worked with back end developers to integrate data into the user interface.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed web applications to analyze data across the Yahoo! network using Javascript/AJAX/DOM, YUI (Yahoo User Interface), CSS, Flash (for charting), and PHP.
* Worked with product managers and interaction designers to enhance user experience for web applications. 
* Worked with back end developers to document and design web services.
* Developed proxy for cross domain compatibility, and data conversion from XML to JSON using PHP.
* Developed and supported a reusable UI tool kit for web applications.
* Hired, trained, and mentored web developers and interns on the web development team.
